'''The Super Elom The Carbon Freezer''' is a [[Dark]] deck by The Super Elom, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds28.htm The Carbon Freezer], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228002732/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds28.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
